source: test fixture — issue #339 review round 6: a FOLDED chip whose rule sentence could not take the ladder's label AND whose display this response has refused
description: drug-reference-renamed-partner.json plus an Esomeprazole entry, so the prescription that renames the partner can be a chip SUBJECT of the same response without being resolvable from the order's own codes. One order displayed 'Esomeprazole 20mg' carrying naproxen's M01AE02 and an A02BC99 the dataset does not cover: DrugSafetyValidator.orderPartners falls to soleSubstanceOf, keys the partner on Naproxen and OrderPartner.nameByOrder renames it after the ORDER. The rule's token 'naproxen' does not name that display, so reconciledPartnerName declines and the rule sentence keeps partnerLabel; the fold then words its class sentence from classPartnerName, and the display names Esomeprazole, which the question puts in play — so CoMedications.displayNamesAnotherChipSubject has refused it for this co-medication and the class sentence must not print it either. Esomeprazole's own A02BC05 is deliberately not the order's second code: were it, entryForAtcCode would name that code and the ORDER rung would never be reached.
